description:
SELF-OPTIMISATION, sense side (2026-07-10). The deep-reader/comprehension process runs SHADOW on every daemon chat turn and mechanically records its own health onto each Message (world_adapter._write_comprehension_to_graph / _record_shadow_health, per CLAUDE.md's adapter-may-maintain-a-rolling-datum exception): speech_act_divergence + comp_kind/shadow_speech_act, shadow_latency_ms + a monotonic shadow_seq, and the Agent-level rolling shadow_latency_recent_avg. This seed is the gap_awareness TWIN for that data: it DECIDES (as graph rules, never Python) when a recorded deficiency is a SelfConcern worth filing, so the agent notices its own comprehension process's problems as ITS OWN gaps, the same way it already notices unresolved topics/reported deficiencies/self-account gaps. Two rules:

(1) note_recurring_speech_act_divergence -- a SINGLE disagreement between the front end's comp_kind and the deep reader's shadow_speech_act is not yet a pattern (comp_kind is deliberately pragmatic in places, per the Wave-3 cutover note in world_adapter.py); RECURRENCE (>=3 Messages sharing the SAME (comp_kind, shadow_speech_act) pair) is the graph's own signal that something is systematically off, not noise. The recurrence count is a held Count/Filter Term over NodesOfType('Message') -- a graph decision, never Python arithmetic. Fires from exactly ONE canonical binding per pair (the EARLIEST divergent Message in the group, selected via the shadow_seq ordering datum: 'no other same-pair divergent Message has a smaller shadow_seq') so a threshold-crossing round can never mint more than one SelfConcern for the same pair even before the content-dedup guard would catch a LATER round's attempt -- both guards compose, belt and braces.

(2) note_comprehension_latency_gap -- a HealthNorm{metric, ceiling} node (seed data below) holds the latency BELIEF the rule compares the Agent's own shadow_latency_recent_avg against: the threshold is data the agent could later revise (teach() a new ceiling), never a Python literal. Fires once per crossing (content-deduped), from the single canonical 'latest shadow-read Message' binding (same shadow_seq trick, applied to ALL shadow-read messages rather than only divergent ones).

Both mint SelfConcern{status:'noted', source:'implicit', kind:'comprehension'|'performance', content:<data>} -- the SAME node shape gap_awareness.json mints, so the existing human-gated promote pipeline (scripts/jabberwock_daemon.py::promote_self_concern -> StandingConcern) and surfacing reader (reflective_faculty._run_self_gaps, 'what gaps do you have?') both find these gaps for free, no new plumbing. seeds/self_optimisation.json is the LAB twin: it gives the promoted 'performance'/'comprehension' concern's self-experiment an EFFICIENCY objective once it reaches the conversation experiment world.

attrs.description: belief: the shadow-read comprehension pass should average under 50ms/turn on the held conversation corpus; a held, revisable threshold -- not a Python literal.

b.value: shadow-read comprehension latency (rolling average) exceeds its held ceiling
